description: This file defines a Migrator class and associated functions for managing database schema migrations in the Mattermost server, including creating migration plans, applying migrations, and initializing migration engine with PostgreSQL driver.

classes.name: Migrator
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema migrations using the morph engine.

methods.name: NewMigrator
methods.description: Creates a new Migrator instance, initializes database connection and migration engine.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the migration engine and cleans up resources.

methods.name: GetFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for a migration plan based on current and target database schema versions.

methods.name: GeneratePlan
methods.description: Generates a migration plan to upgrade the database schema.

methods.name: MigrateWithPlan
methods.description: Applies a given migration plan to the database.

methods.name: DowngradeMigrations
methods.description: Generates and applies a migration plan to downgrade the database schema to specified versions.
